_note: Mock-mode LLM phrasebook (LLM_MODE=mock). Each move has several variants; the mock picks one per conversation and never repeats a sentence used in the last 10 AI messages. Rules: no emojis, no exclamation marks, at most 2 questions per message. Live mode ignores this file and generates every reply.

intro: I'm {org_poss} assistant and can help right away.
This is {org_poss} assistant. I can help you with this now.
I'm the assistant for {org}, and I can take this from here.
consent: We'll save your details to help with your search, and you can reply STOP at any time.
Your details will be saved only to help you find a home. Reply STOP at any time to opt out.
We keep your details only for this search, and you can reply STOP whenever you like.

ack_listing_taken: The {title} has just been taken, but I can show you similar homes.

answer_service_charge: The service charge is {value} a year.
Service charge on that home is {value} a year.
answer_unknown: I don't have that detail yet, so an agent will confirm it for you.
An agent will confirm that detail for you shortly.

The home is in {area}. The location pin comes with the viewing confirmation.
answer_documents: An agent will take you through the title documents before any payment.
Documents are confirmed by an agent with you in person, before any payment.
answer_payment_plan: There is a {value} on this one.
